name: sched_getscheduler
description: Retrieves the current scheduling policy of the thread identified by the specified pid. If pid is zero, it returns the policy of the calling thread.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The ID of the thread to query. If zero, the policy of the calling thread is retrieved.

return_value.success: Returns the scheduling policy as a nonnegative integer
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Invalid arguments, such as pid being negative
The calling thread does not have appropriate privileges
The thread whose ID is pid could not be found
